title: An LLM agent in an air-free robotic lab maps lithium halide spinel conductors
summary: An April 2026 arXiv preprint reports 352 lithium-halide spinel samples, covering72% of 171 metal pairs drawn from 19 metals. The proportion meeting conductivity above 0.05 mS/cm and high spinel purity rose from 1.33% in the first 75 agent-proposed samples to 5.33% in the final 75. LLM agents selected experiments; characterization used X-ray diffraction and impedance spectroscopy with manual handling steps. These are within-study laboratory results.
ai_technology: A-Lab GPSS (LLM agent integrated into a robotic synthesis platform)
organization: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory; University of California, Berkeley; Argonne National Laboratory; Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology; Florida State University

evidence.tested: Robotic synthesis with semi-automated XRD and impedance measurements.
evidence.unknown: Not assessed: supplements and scalability outside this campaign. Manual sample handling remains in the characterization workflow.
evidence.ai_role: LLM agents used abductive and inductive reasoning for experimental design.
